mapping.zh: 方程 a/b=v 建边 a→b 权 v、b→a 权 1/v。查询沿路径乘积得到比值，图中不存在的变量即使除以自身也未定义。
mapping.en: Equation a/b=v gives edges a→b with weight v and b→a with 1/v. Query ratios are path products, while unknown variables remain undefined even in self-queries.

why.zh: 路径乘积中的中间变量逐项约分，例如 (a/b)(b/c)=a/c。输入保证无矛盾，因此同一对已定义变量的任意可达路径给出一致比值。遍历找到一条路径即可；存在性检查避免错误把未知 x/x 当作 1。
why.en: Intermediate variables cancel in path products, as (a/b)(b/c)=a/c. Consistent input makes all routes between defined connected variables agree, so any found path suffices. Checking existence prevents incorrectly accepting undefined x/x as one.

trace.zh:
方程 a/b=2、b/c=3。
1. 从 a 起始乘积 1，到 b 变成 2。
2. 再到 c 变成 6，因此 a/c=6。
3. b/a 走倒数边为 0.5；未知 x/x 返回 -1。
trace.en:
Equations a/b=2,b/c=3.
1. From a, product one becomes two at b.
2. It becomes six at c, giving a/c=6.
3. The reciprocal edge gives b/a=0.5, while unknown x/x returns -1.

mapping.zh: dp[i] 表示从第 i 题到结尾的最大分数。跳过进入 i+1，作答获得本题分数后直接跳到冷却结束的位置，倒序计算即可。
mapping.en: Let dp[i] be the maximum score from question i onward. Skip to i+1 or solve and jump beyond its cooldown, computing backward.

why.zh: 任意合法方案在 i 处只有跳过或作答两种首步。各首步之后的剩余问题都是独立后缀，dp 精确给出最优后续；两者取最大覆盖所有方案。next>i 使倒序时依赖均已完成。
why.en: At i every valid plan either skips or solves. Each choice leaves an independent suffix whose optimum is already in dp. Taking their maximum is exhaustive, and next>i makes backward evaluation valid.

trace.zh:
questions=[[3,2],[4,3],[4,4],[2,5]]。
1. 最后题能得 2 分。
2. 作答第 0 题后跳过 1、2，接第 3 题，得 3+2=5。
3. 跳过第 0 题最多得 4，因此返回 5。
trace.en:
questions=[[3,2],[4,3],[4,4],[2,5]].
1. The final question offers two points.
2. Solving question zero skips one and two, then adds final two for five.
3. Skipping zero yields at most four.

mapping.zh: 两侧街道独立，先算单侧不相邻放房方案，再平方。单侧只保留末位为空与有房两种状态。
mapping.en: The street sides are independent. Count nonadjacent house placements on one side and square it, retaining only empty-ending and house-ending states.

why.zh: 按末格是否有房将全部单侧方案分成不重不漏两类，状态转移恰表达相邻限制。两侧没有相互影响，每对单侧方案对应唯一整街方案，因此使用乘法原理平方。
why.en: Splitting by the last slot partitions single-side configurations exactly, and the transition enforces adjacency. Each pair of independent side configurations gives one street configuration, so multiply their equal counts.

trace.zh:
n=2。
1. 单侧长度 1 的 empty、house 各 1。
2. 长度 2 得 empty=2、house=1，单侧三种：空空、房空、空房。
3. 两侧独立组合 3×3=9。
trace.en:
n=2.
1. Each ending state has count one after the first slot.
2. The second gives empty=2,house=1, three single-side patterns.
3. Independent sides yield nine pairs.

mapping.zh: dp[d] 表示覆盖到第 d 天所有出行的最小价。非出行日沿用前一天，出行日枚举覆盖当天的 1、7、30 天票。
mapping.en: dp[d] is the minimum cost covering all travel through day d. Carry non-travel days forward and try 1-,7-,30-day passes on travel days.

why.zh: 覆盖当天的最后一张票可选择三种有效期，分别能同时覆盖从 d-L+1 到 d 的出行，剩余更早需求由 dp[d-L] 最优覆盖。枚举票种完整；非出行日没有新增需求，沿用既有最小价即可。
why.en: A pass covering day d has one of three lengths and can cover the interval d-L+1 through d; earlier travel is optimally covered by dp[d-L]. Trying all lengths is complete, while non-travel days add no requirement.

trace.zh:
days=[1,4,6,7,8,20]，costs=[2,7,15]。
1. 可用一天票覆盖第 1 天。
2. 一张七天票覆盖 4..10，统一覆盖 4、6、7、8。
3. 第 20 天再买一天票，总价 2+7+2=11，为最优。
trace.en:
days=[1,4,6,7,8,20], costs=[2,7,15].
1. A one-day pass covers day one.
2. A seven-day pass for days 4..10 covers four more trips.
3. Another one-day pass covers twenty, totaling eleven.

mapping.zh: 选数值 v 会排除 v-1、v+1，但同值副本可以全部赚取。先按值聚合积分，再把相邻数值冲突转成打家劫舍。
mapping.en: Choosing value v excludes v-1 and v+1, while all copies of v can be collected. Aggregate points by value and solve the resulting adjacent-value house-robber problem.

why.zh: 同值元素互不删除，选某值后收集其所有副本不会更差。不同值之间仅相差 1 时冲突，恰等价于一条按数值排序路径上的相邻选择限制；两状态 DP 完整覆盖取或不取。
why.en: Equal values do not eliminate one another, so collecting all copies after choosing a value is never worse. Only consecutive values conflict, exactly the adjacency restriction on a value-indexed path. Take/skip DP covers both possibilities.

trace.zh:
nums=[3,4,2]。
1. 聚合为 points[2]=2、points[3]=3、points[4]=4。
2. 选 3 只能得 3，而选 2 后仍可选 4。
3. 最佳为 2+4=6。
trace.en:
nums=[3,4,2].
1. Aggregate two,three,four points at values 2,3,4.
2. Choosing three excludes both neighbors.
3. Choosing two and four earns six.

mapping.zh: 先假设所有奶酪给第二只鼠，再选择恰好 k 块改给第一只。每次改变增加 reward1-reward2，只需选最大的 k 个差值。
mapping.en: Give every cheese to mouse two as a baseline, then switch exactly k pieces to mouse one. Each switch gains reward1-reward2, so take the k greatest differences.

why.zh: 任意合法分配与恰好 k 个改动集合一一对应，目标等于固定基线加集合差值和。若选中较小差值而漏掉更大的，交换后不会变差；重复交换得到最大的 k 项，因此排序选择最优。
why.en: Each valid allocation corresponds to exactly k switches, with score equal to baseline plus their gain sum. Exchanging a selected smaller gain for an omitted larger one never hurts, proving that the k greatest gains are optimal.

trace.en:
reward1=[1,1,3,4], reward2=[4,4,1,1], k=2.
1. Baseline ten, gains [-3,-3,2,3].
2. Switch gains three and two.
3. Total fifteen, leaving the first two pieces to mouse two.

mapping.zh: 先合并右侧会让右邻块更大，从而更容易满足左值≤右块的合并条件。因此从右向左维护能形成的最大紧邻块。
mapping.en: Merging on the right enlarges the adjacent block and can only help satisfy left≤right. Maintain the greatest attainable leading block of the processed suffix.

why.zh: 归纳维护 current 是处理后缀中最大的可得块，且从该后缀首位置开始。能合并时，使用最大的右块使新总和最大；不能时，任何较小右块也不满足条件，当前值单独成为新最大。正值保证合并后更大，重启条件也保证新值超过旧最大，所以最终 current 是全局最优。
why.en: Inductively current is the largest attainable block in the processed suffix and starts at its first position. When mergeable, the largest right block maximizes the new sum; otherwise every smaller right block also fails and the current value becomes the new maximum. Positivity preserves global maximality in both cases.

trace.zh:
nums=[2,3,7,9,3]。
1. 从末尾 3 开始，左边 9>3，重启为 9。
2. 7≤9，合成 16；再吸收 3 得 19。
3. 再吸收 2 得 21，最后那个未合并的 3 不影响最大值。
trace.en:
nums=[2,3,7,9,3].
1. Start at three; nine is larger and starts a new block.
2. Absorb seven to get sixteen, then three to get nineteen.
3. Absorb two to get twenty-one; the separate final three is smaller.

mapping.zh: 相撞相减可展开为原重量带正负号的和，最小剩余等价于把石头分成总和尽量接近的两组。只需找不超过总和一半的最大子集和。
mapping.en: Repeated differences expand into signed original weights. The optimum is the most balanced two-group partition, found by maximizing a subset sum no greater than half the total.

why.zh: 任意碰撞结果都是某个带符号和，因此至少达到最优二分差的下界。取最优二分，让跨组石头逐次抵消；若最后同组还剩多块，再碰撞会得到更小的带符号差，违背最优，所以最优差可实现。最大化半和以下的一组就最小化两组差。
why.en: Any collision result is a signed sum, bounded below by the best partition difference. Cross-cancel an optimal partition; if multiple stones remained on one side, further collision would yield a smaller signed difference, contradicting optimality. Thus the bound is attainable and maximizing the smaller group minimizes the difference.

stones=[2,7,4,1,8,1]，总和 23。
1. 容量取 11。
2. 可选 [7,4] 凑到 11，另一组总重 12。
3. 差为 23-2×11=1，无法降到负数或比 1 更小的同奇偶差。
trace.en:
stones=[2,7,4,1,8,1], total twenty-three.
1. Capacity is eleven.
2. Subset [7,4] reaches eleven, leaving twelve.
3. Return difference one.

mapping.zh: 每个字符串是一个只能选一次的物品，消耗零和一两种资源，收益为 1。容量需要两个维度，而不是字符串长度一个维度。
mapping.en: Each string is a once-only item consuming separate zero and one budgets and contributing one selected item. Use a two-dimensional capacity state.

why.zh: 对当前字符串，任一最优方案要么不选，沿用旧状态；要么选一次并消耗对应两种容量，接上更小容量的旧最优。两维倒序确保读取的前驱未使用当前串，正好实现 0/1 选择。
why.en: An optimum either skips the string or takes it once and combines it with a previous optimum under both reduced budgets. Descending updates keep predecessor states free of the current item, enforcing zero-one selection.

trace.en:
strs=[10,0001,111001,1,0], budgets five zeros and three ones.
1. Select 10 and 0001, costing (4,2).
2. Add 1 and 0 to reach (5,3).
3. Four strings fit; 111001 alone needs four ones.

mapping.zh: 下一奖励必须大于当前总和，因此合法选择必严格递增。排序后做受限可达和 DP，只允许从 sum<当前奖励的状态转移。
mapping.en: Each next reward must exceed the accumulated total, forcing strictly increasing chosen values. Sort and update reachable sums only from totals below the current reward.

why.zh: 若前一步奖励为 a，总和至少为 a，所以下一步一定更大，排序不漏任何合法顺序。限制前驱 sum<v 精确表达操作要求，转移覆盖所有合法递增选择。最后一次奖励≤M，之前总和小于它，所以最终总和严格小于 2M。
why.en: After choosing a, the accumulated total is at least a, forcing the next value larger; sorted processing loses no valid order. The predecessor bound sum<v is exactly the rule. Before the final reward≤M, total is below it, proving the 2M range bound.

mapping.zh: dp[s] 表示整数 s 至少拆两段时的最大乘积。固定第一段 a 后，剩余 b 可以保持一段，也可以继续用 dp[b] 拆分。
mapping.en: dp[s] is the greatest product splitting s into at least two positive parts. Fix first part a and either keep the remainder b whole or split it using dp[b].

why.zh: 任意合法拆分都有一个第一段，其余部分要么单段要么多段，恰对应两个候选。第一段与剩余都正数，保证至少拆一次；枚举全部 a 并使用更小状态最优值，覆盖全部拆分。
why.en: Every legal partition has a first part and either one or multiple remaining parts, exactly the two candidates. Both portions are positive, enforcing a real split. Trying all first parts and optimal smaller states covers every partition.

trace.zh:

trace.en:

1. First part three leaves seven, whose split 3+4 gives twelve.
2. Multiply to get thirty-six.
3. Other first parts do not improve it; n=2 must split into 1+1.

mapping.zh: 不需要保存所有子集和，只保留每种余数下的最大可达和。新数字可跳过或加入旧状态，较小的同余和永远不优于较大的。
mapping.en: Retain only the greatest reachable sum per remainder. Each value is skipped or added to an old state, and a smaller sum of the same remainder is never better.

why.zh: 后续添加相同数时，同余和的余数变化相同，较大的和始终保持更大，所以每类只保留最大值足够。复制保留不选方案，从旧层转移保留选一次方案，归纳得到所有子集的最优余数摘要。
why.en: Adding the same future values changes equal remainders identically while preserving their sum ordering, so one maximum per class suffices. Copying represents skipping; old-layer transitions represent taking once, preserving the optimal summary of every subset.

trace.zh:

2. 加入 1 后，与已有余数状态组合可形成更多候选。
3. 最优选择 3+6+1+8=18，舍去 5；全体和 23 不能直接返回。
trace.en:
nums=[3,6,5,1,8].
1. Three and six make remainder-zero sum nine.
2. One combines with earlier remainder states.

mapping.zh: 先把 F(n)=F(n-1)+F(n-2) 看成递归树。同一 F(k) 会在不同分支重复出现；备忘录合并重复子树，按下标填表又能去掉递归栈。最后发现只依赖前两项，可压缩成两个变量。
mapping.en: Begin with the recursion tree F(n)=F(n-1)+F(n-2). Repeated subtrees become memoized states; filling them in index order removes recursion, and two preceding values suffice instead of a full table.

why.zh: 初值满足相邻两项的不变量。一次更新把旧 F(i+1) 移到 a，再把两项之和 F(i+2) 移到 b，所以归纳到第 n 轮得到 F(n)。这个入门例子训练的是重叠子问题与依赖顺序，不需要强行解释成求最大或最小。
why.en: The initial pair satisfies the consecutive-value invariant. Updating moves F(i+1) to a and its sum with F(i) to b, proving the invariant inductively. This introductory example teaches overlapping subproblems and dependency order without requiring an optimization objective.

trace.en:
n=4.
1. Begin at (0,1), representing F(0),F(1).
2. Three rounds produce (1,1), (1,2), (2,3).
3. The fourth gives (3,5); return a=3 rather than the next term b.

mapping.zh: 格子是数据，整个棋盘才是图的一个节点。一次合法交换是一条单位边，因此从起始棋盘做 BFS，第一层到达目标时就是最少步数。
mapping.en: A cell holds data; an entire board is one graph vertex. Each legal swap is one unit edge, so the first BFS arrival at the target has minimum distance.

why.zh: 任一操作序列都对应状态图中的路径，路径长度就是操作次数。FIFO 分层按距离递增展开，第一次到达的状态已有最短距离，重复状态无需再扩展。枚举空格全部合法邻位覆盖所有操作，因而不会漏掉可解路径。
why.en: Every operation sequence is a path whose length equals its move count. FIFO layers visit states in nondecreasing distance, making the first arrival shortest. Enumerating all blank neighbors includes every legal move, while marking states removes redundant cycles.

trace.en:
board=[[1,2,3],[4,0,5]].
1. Encode 123405 with blank index four.
2. Swap with indices one, three or five to form the next layer.
3. Swapping with five reaches 123450 at distance one; the reversed-four/five configuration exhausts its component and returns -1.

mapping.zh: 先写直接状态 T(e,f)：枚举首扔楼层 x，取 1+max(T(e-1,x-1),T(e,f-x))，再对 x 求最小。为省去枚举，反问“m 次、e 个蛋最多能处理多少层”，得到覆盖量 DP。
mapping.en: Start with T(e,f): minimize 1+max(T(e-1,x-1),T(e,f-x)) over first-drop floors x. To avoid enumerating x, reverse the question: how many floors can m moves and e eggs resolve?

why.zh: 首扔楼层把楼分成下方、当前层、上方。碎了只能用 e-1 个蛋和 m-1 次处理下方，不碎可用 e 个蛋和 m-1 次处理上方；两分支都必须能解决，因此覆盖量恰为两边容量加 1。把首扔放在下方容量之后可实现此界。覆盖量随次数单调，首次足够即最少。
why.en: A first drop divides floors below, the tested floor, and floors above. Breaking leaves e-1 eggs; survival leaves e, both with m-1 moves. Their capacities plus one give an exact bound attained by placing the first drop just above the lower capacity. Monotonic coverage makes the first sufficient budget optimal.

trace.zh:

2. 两次时分别为 2、3。

trace.en:
k=2, n=6.

2. Two moves cover two floors with one egg and three with two.
3. Three moves cover 2+1+3=6, so return three. With one egg coverage grows by only one each move.

mapping.zh: 把每个位置看作从它到最底层的子问题。下一步只有左下和右下，故从最后一行往上填表，不需要枚举全部路径。
mapping.en: Treat each position as a suffix path to the bottom. Only two children are possible, so fill upward instead of enumerating paths.

why.zh: 底层到自身的最小和就是其值。任一路径从当前格必进入两个孩子之一，最优后缀可独立选择，取较小再加当前值即最优。行内从左向右更新时，dp[j+1] 还属于下一行，满足依赖。
why.en: Bottom states equal their values. Every path must use one of the two children, whose optimal suffixes give the recurrence. Updating a row left-to-right preserves the next-row value at dp[j+1].

mapping.zh: 正数排序后，若前驱整除当前值，就能延长它的整除链。整除关系具有传递性，因此链中任意两个数都满足题意。
mapping.en: Sort positive values and extend a predecessor chain when its last value divides the current value. Divisibility is transitive, so every pair in the chain is valid.

why.zh: 任一以 a[i] 结束的合法子集，去掉最大值后仍是合法子集，其最大值必须整除 a[i]。枚举所有此前最大值就覆盖最优前驱；整除传递性保证接入后不会破坏其他配对。
why.en: Removing the greatest value of a valid subset leaves a valid subset whose greatest value divides it. Considering every predecessor covers the optimum, and transitivity makes extending the chain safe.

trace.en:
nums=[1,2,4,8].
1. One starts a chain of length one.
2. Two, four and eight extend the longest divisible predecessor.
3. Trace 8→4→2→1 and reverse.

mapping.zh: 连续子数组要求相邻位置一起延长。dp[j] 表示当前前缀的 A 末尾与 B[j-1] 末尾的最长公共后缀，失配必须清零。
mapping.en: Contiguous matches extend adjacent positions together. dp[j] is the longest common suffix ending at the current A item and B[j-1]; mismatch resets it.

why.zh: 一个公共连续后缀要么末值不同长度为零，要么去掉相同末值后仍是公共连续后缀，长度恰加一。倒序读取上一行左上角，枚举每个末尾就不会漏掉任意位置的最优子数组。
why.en: A common suffix has length zero on mismatch; on equality, removing the last pair leaves the preceding common suffix. Backward updates preserve that diagonal predecessor, and examining every endpoint finds the global optimum.

2. The following two and one extend it to three.
3. Later mismatches reset local states while the saved maximum remains three.

mapping.zh: 保留各自相对顺序，相当于在两个前缀长度组成的网格上走。状态 (i,j) 表示 s1 前 i 个和 s2 前 j 个能否拼出 s3 前 i+j 个。

why.zh: 任何合法交错的最后一个字符必取自两串之一，删掉后正好落在上方或左方前驱。两种来源取或覆盖全部可能，初始空前缀唯一可达。正序列更新有意同时使用旧上方与新左方。
why.en: The final character of any valid interleaving comes from one source, leaving the upper or left prefix state. Their disjunction covers all possibilities, starting with reachable empty prefixes. Forward updates intentionally combine old upper and new left states.

mapping.zh: 以每格为右下角定义全 1 正方形最大边长。当前是 1 时，向左、向上和左上三块都必须足够大，故取三者最小再加 1。

why.zh: 边长 L 的正方形必含三个边长 L-1 的邻接正方形，因此受最小值限制；反过来三块加当前 1 覆盖了整个边长 min+1 的方形，所以这个限制也可达到。
why.en: A side-L square contains three neighboring side-(L-1) squares, imposing the minimum bound. Conversely those three squares together with the current one cell cover the entire proposed square, so the bound is attainable.

mapping.zh: 把从低格到严格更高邻格看作有向边。沿边数值递增，不可能出现环，所以每格最长后缀可用记忆化 DFS 计算一次。
mapping.en: Direct edges from each cell to strictly greater adjacent cells. Strict increase forbids cycles, so memoized DFS computes each longest suffix once.

why.zh: 严格递增使状态图为 DAG，递归必终止。任一非空路径要么只含本格，要么选一个更高邻格后接它的最优后缀。枚举四邻并记忆其最优值覆盖全部合法路径，且不同起点可共享后缀结果。
why.en: Strict increase creates a DAG. A path is either this cell alone or a move to one higher neighbor followed by its optimum suffix. Considering all neighbors covers every path, and memoization shares suffix results across starting cells.

trace.en:
matrix=[[9,9,4],[6,6,8],[2,1,1]].

2. Continue to six and nine.

mapping.zh: 按结束时间排序，dp[i] 是前 i 份工作最大收益。选择当前工作时，只能接在结束时间≤其开始时间的前缀后，用二分找到这个前缀长度。
mapping.en: Sort by finish time; dp[i] is the best reward among the first i jobs. Taking the current job combines it with the prefix ending no later than its start, found by binary search.

why.zh: 任一前缀最优方案要么不含最后工作，要么含它。含它时，其余工作必须全部落在兼容前缀；在该前缀内采用最优收益不会增加冲突。因此两种选择取最大即前缀最优。
why.en: An optimum either excludes the final job or includes it. Including it restricts every other job to the compatible prefix, where the optimum reward remains compatible. Maximizing these two cases is exact.

2. A job starting at three can follow one ending at three.
3. Rewards fifty and seventy combine to one hundred twenty.

mapping.zh: 已经覆盖 [0,current] 后，所有 start≤current 的片段都能接上；只需选择其中能把右端推得最远的一段，再开始下一轮。
mapping.en: After covering [0,current], every clip starting no later than current is usable. Choose the greatest reachable endpoint, then repeat.

why.zh: 任何下一段都不能从 current 之后开始，否则产生缺口。在可接片段中，右端更远只会增加后续选择，不会破坏覆盖；用最远者替换任意最优方案的下一段不增加数量，逐轮交换得到最优。
why.en: A clip beginning after current leaves a gap. Among usable clips, a farther endpoint only expands future options. Replacing an optimum solution’s next clip by the farthest one preserves feasibility without adding clips; repeating proves optimality.

2. A clip starting by two extends it to five.
3. Then [4,6] completes three clips; starting the middle clip at three instead leaves a gap.

mapping.zh: 已排序输入用 freq 记录剩余次数，用 need[x] 记录等待 x 延长的序列数。优先续接旧序列；否则必须消耗 x,x+1,x+2 建一个至少长三的新序列。
mapping.en: For sorted input, freq tracks unused values and need[x] counts sequences awaiting x. Extend an existing sequence first; otherwise consume x,x+1,x+2 to start a valid length-three sequence.

why.zh: 最小未分配 x 不能放到未来起点更大的序列中。考虑任意可行完结：若选定的旧段后续本就使用 x，续接与它一致；若旧段止于 x-1，而 x 用来新建一段，把新段整体接到旧段后即可，所有数字仍被合法分配。因此优先续接不损失可行解。没有可续接旧段时，x 只能新建，接下来两个值不可缺。
why.en: The smallest unused x cannot belong to a sequence starting later. In any feasible completion, either the selected existing sequence already continues with x, or it ends at x-1. In the latter case, concatenate it with the new sequence starting at x, preserving a valid allocation. Thus extending first cannot remove feasibility. With no waiting tail, x must start a sequence and requires its next two values.

trace.zh:
nums=[1,2,3,3,4,5]。
1. 用 1,2,3 建一段，等待 4。
2. 还有一个 3，不能接在等待 4 的段后，于是用 3,4,5 再建一段。
3. 得到两条长度 3 的连续序列，返回 true；[1,2,3,4,4,5] 会因最后一段不够长失败。
trace.en:
nums=[1,2,3,3,4,5].
1. Build 1,2,3, leaving a tail waiting for four.
2. The other three starts 3,4,5 because it cannot extend that tail.
3. Both length-three sequences are valid; [1,2,3,4,4,5] cannot give every sequence sufficient length.

mapping.zh: 把转换拆成明确阶段：跳过开头空格、读取可选符号、连续读取数字、在首个其他字符处停止。读每一位前判断是否越过有符号 32 位范围。
mapping.en: Use explicit parsing phases: leading spaces, an optional sign, consecutive digits, then stop at the first other character. Check the signed 32-bit bound before each digit is accumulated.

why.zh: 每轮已读数字的准确值由 value 保存。先比较再乘十，保证即使输入很长也不会发生中间溢出。超过范围后，追加任何数字都不能回到范围内，因此可立刻饱和返回。没有读到数字时 value=0。
why.en: The accumulator equals the exact parsed prefix. Checking before multiplication prevents intermediate overflow even for very long inputs. Once out of range, further digits cannot restore it, so clamping is final. Reading no digits leaves zero.

trace.zh:
s="   -42abc"。
1. 跳过三个开头空格，读取负号。
2. 读 4 得 4，再读 2 得 42。
3. 遇到 a 停止，返回 -42；"+-12" 因第二个符号不是数字返回 0。
trace.en:
s="   -42abc".
1. Skip three spaces and read the minus sign.
2. Read four, then forty-two.
3. Stop at a and return -42; "+-12" has no digits after its first sign and returns zero.

mapping.zh: 无需把整个整数反转，只把末尾一半数字移到 reversed。两半长度相等或相差一位时即可判断，减少溢出风险。
mapping.en: Reverse only the trailing half of the digits. Compare equal-length halves or ignore the center digit for odd length, avoiding full-number reversal.

why.zh: 每次转移都把原数末尾一位按逆序加入 reversed，未处理部分仍在 x。循环停止时至少处理了一半位数；回文两半必须相等，奇数位只多一个无须比较的中间位。非零尾零会需要前导零，提前排除。
why.en: Each transfer appends a reversed trailing digit while x retains the unprocessed prefix. At termination at least half the digits have moved; palindrome halves must match, ignoring a sole center digit. A nonzero trailing zero would require a leading zero and is rejected.

trace.en:
x=12321.
1. First transfer gives (1232,1).
2. Continue to (123,12), then (12,123).
3. Compare twelve with 123/10 and return true.

mapping.zh: 指数每次减半，底数每次平方。指数当前二进制位为 1 时，把对应底数乘入答案；负指数先取底数倒数。
mapping.en: Halve the exponent while squaring the base. Multiply the current base into the answer for each set bit; invert the base for negative exponents.

why.zh: 保持 result×x^exponent 等于目标。奇数指数先提出一个 x，再把剩余偶数指数折半；偶数指数直接使用 x^(2q)=(x²)^q。每步保持不变量，指数为零时 result 即答案。
why.en: Maintain result×x^exponent equal to the target. For odd exponents take one x, then halve the remaining even exponent; for even exponents use x^(2q)=(x²)^q. At exponent zero, result is the target.

trace.zh:
x=2、n=10。
1. 指数 10 为偶数，底数平方到 4、指数变 5。
2. 取 4，再平方到 16、指数 2；再平方到 256、指数 1。
3. 取 256 得到 1024。n=-2 时先用底数 1/2，结果为 1/4。
trace.en:
x=2, n=10.
1. Even ten becomes base four and exponent five.
2. Take four, then square through sixteen to 256 as the exponent reaches one.
3. Take 256 to obtain 1024; exponent -2 instead uses base one-half and gives one-quarter.

mapping.zh: 从低位到高位做竖式加法，每位总和由两个输入位和上次进位组成。输出位为 sum%2，新进位为 sum/2。
mapping.en: Perform column addition from least significant bits, combining two input bits and carry. Emit sum%2 and retain sum/2.

why.zh: 处理完某一列时，该列的 sum 在二进制下唯一分解为低位加两倍进位。逐列保留这一分解，已输出低位准确，待处理高位只需继承一个进位。结束时全部位权均已处理。
why.en: Each column sum uniquely decomposes into a bit plus twice the next carry. This preserves exact emitted low bits while summarizing their effect on higher columns in one carry. Termination accounts for every place value.

trace.en:
a=1010, b=1011.
1. The low column produces one.
2. The next produces zero with carry, then the following produces one.
3. The highest input column produces zero with final carry one, yielding 10101.

mapping.zh: 无限数字串按一位数、两位数、三位数分块。d 位数有 9×10^(d-1) 个，先跳过整块，再定位块内数字及其某一位。
mapping.en: Group the infinite string by digit length. There are 9×10^(d-1) d-digit numbers; skip whole groups, then locate a number and its digit offset.

why.zh: 同位数数字每个贡献相同数量字符，块长度可直接相乘。跳块后 n 仍从 1 开始计数，减一转成零基索引，商表示跳过多少完整数字，余数表示目标数字内的位置。
why.en: Every number in a group contributes the same length. After skipping groups, n is still one-based; subtracting one makes its quotient count complete numbers and its remainder identify the character within the next number.

trace.zh:
n=11。
1. 跳过 1..9 的九位字符，块内 n=2。
2. 两位块起点为 10，目标数字 10+(2-1)/2=10。
3. 取下标 1，得到 0。
trace.en:
n=11.
1. Skip nine one-digit characters, leaving n=2.
2. In the two-digit group, containing number is 10+(2-1)/2=10.
3. Offset one selects zero.

mapping.zh: 指数太长不能转整数。逐位读取十进制指数，若旧前缀为 p、新位为 d，则新指数为 10p+d，已有结果 r=a^p 可更新成 r^10×a^d。
mapping.en: The exponent is too long to parse as an integer. Reading digit d after prefix p gives exponent 10p+d, so an existing r=a^p updates to r^10×a^d.

why.zh: 由 a^(10p+d)=(a^p)^10×a^d，且乘法与取模可交换顺序，每次更新都保持“answer 是当前指数前缀对应的幂模数”。不依赖底数与 1337 互质，对 7、191 等因子也成立。
why.en: The exponent law a^(10p+d)=(a^p)^10×a^d and modular multiplication preserve the prefix invariant. No coprimality assumption is needed, including bases divisible by factors seven or 191.

trace.en:
a=2, b=[1,0].
1. Start with answer one.
2. Reading one yields 1^10×2=2.
3. Reading zero yields 2^10×1=1024 without parsing the exponent.

mapping.zh: 统计 [0,10^n) 中各位互异的整数，按实际位数分类。零单独计一个；一位正数有 9 个，后续位不能与之前重复。
mapping.en: Count distinct-digit integers in [0,10^n) by actual digit length. Count zero separately; positive leading digits have nine choices and later digits exclude previously used digits.

why.zh: 首位不能为零，有 9 种；第二位可用零但不能等于首位，有 9 种；第三位排除已有两位，剩 8 种。乘法原理计出每个长度，长度不同的集合互斥，相加不会重复。十进制最多十位互异。
why.en: The first digit has nine nonzero choices. The second may be zero but not the first digit, giving nine choices; the third has eight. Multiplication counts each fixed length, and disjoint lengths can be summed. At most ten decimal digits can be distinct.

trace.en:
n=2.
1. Zero through nine contribute ten.
2. Two-digit numbers contribute 9×9=81, excluding 11,22 and similar repeats.
3. Total is ninety-one; n=0 covers only [0,1).

mapping.zh: 前两个数一旦确定，后续每个数都被加法唯一决定。因此只枚举前两个切点，剩余部分逐项验证；数字可能很长，用字符串竖式加法而非整数。
mapping.en: Once the first two numbers are fixed, addition uniquely determines the remainder. Enumerate their cut points, then verify the forced suffix with decimal string arithmetic.

why.zh: 任意合法序列都有唯一的前两个切点，枚举不会漏掉它。固定后每项必须是前两项之和，验证不存在分支；每次推进到精确匹配的末尾，最终恰好覆盖全部输入便是合法拆分。字符串加法避免了输入长度与整数范围之间的冲突。
why.en: Every valid sequence has two initial boundaries considered by enumeration. After those, each next value is forced; exact prefix matching validates the sole continuation. Complete consumption proves a valid split, and string addition handles numbers beyond machine range.

trace.en:
num=199100199.
1. Choose one and ninety-nine.
2. Their sum one hundred matches the next prefix.
3. Ninety-nine plus one hundred matches the final 199, completing the sequence.

mapping.zh: 与累加数同样先确定两项，再验证强制后缀；本题还要求每项≤2^31-1，故前两项最多各十位，可用 int64 计算和并及时检查上限。
mapping.en: Choose the first two terms, then verify the forced suffix as with additive numbers. Each term must fit signed 32-bit range, limiting initial terms to ten digits; use int64 sums and enforce the bound.

why.zh: 任意合法首两项都在枚举范围内。固定后加法唯一确定所有下一项，验证每个和的范围及精确字符匹配即充分且必要。枚举完没有成功就不存在合法序列，返回任意一个成功序列即可。
why.en: Every valid initial pair lies within the enumerated bounds. Each subsequent term is uniquely forced, so range checking and exact matching are both necessary and sufficient. Exhausting all pairs proves failure; any successful sequence is acceptable.

trace.zh:
num=123456579。
1. 枚举到首两项 123、456。
2. 和为 579，未超上限并匹配剩余字符。
3. 完整消费后返回 [123,456,579]；0123 因前导零不能选择 01。
trace.en:
num=123456579.
1. Consider initial terms 123 and 456.
2. Their sum 579 fits the bound and matches the remaining characters.
3. Return [123,456,579]; 0123 cannot use 01 because of its leading zero.

mapping.zh: 先想象两个空篮子：小于 x 的节点放左边，其余放右边。各篮子只在尾部追加，保留原有先后顺序，最后连接两条链。
mapping.en: Imagine two initially empty baskets: nodes below x go left and all others go right. Appending only at each tail preserves input order; concatenate the chains at the end.

why.zh: 扫描前缀中的每个节点被准确分到一条链，且追加次序就是原出现次序，这个不变量每步保持。两条链分别满足大小条件，连接后所有小值在前；每个原节点恰好出现一次且同组顺序不变。
why.en: Each processed node belongs to exactly one chain in its original encounter order, an invariant preserved by tail insertion. Concatenation places all smaller nodes first, uses every original node exactly once and preserves within-group order.

trace.zh:
head=1→4→3→2→5→2，x=3。
1. 处理 1、4、3 后，小值链为 1，大值链为 4→3。
2. 两个 2 按出现顺序接到小值链，5 接到大值链。
3. 连接得到 1→2→2→4→3→5；两个值为 2 的节点身份与相对顺序不变。
trace.en:
head=1→4→3→2→5→2, x=3.
1. The first three nodes produce small chain 1 and large chain 4→3.
2. Both twos append in encounter order; five appends to the large chain.
3. Concatenate into 1→2→2→4→3→5, preserving node identities and order.

mapping.zh: 若先数长度再走一半，需要两次遍历。让 fast 每轮走两步、slow 走一步，当 fast 到尾部时 slow 已完成一半路程。
mapping.en: Counting length then walking halfway needs two passes. Instead move fast two links and slow one per round; when fast reaches the end, slow has traversed half.

why.zh: 做 t 轮后 slow 位于下标 t，fast 已走 2t 条边或到空。n=2q 时恰做 q 轮，slow 为下标 q；n=2q+1 时做 q 轮，也是下标 q。分别对应第二中点与唯一中点。
why.en: After t rounds slow is at index t and fast has taken 2t links or reached null. Length 2q performs q rounds, selecting index q as the second middle; length 2q+1 also selects index q as its unique middle.

trace.zh:
head=1→2→3→4→5→6。
1. 一轮后 slow=2、fast=3。
2. 两轮后 slow=3、fast=5。
3. 三轮后 slow=4、fast=nil，返回节点 4，而非第一个中点 3。
trace.en:
head=1→2→3→4→5→6.
1. After one round slow=2, fast=3.
2. After two slow=3, fast=5.
3. After three slow=4, fast=null; return the second middle four.

mapping.zh: 倒数位置可以转成固定间距：fast 比 slow 提前 cnt 条边，之后同时向前。当 fast 到空位置，slow 正好还差 cnt 条边到空。
mapping.en: Convert an end-relative position into a fixed gap: place fast cnt links ahead, then advance both. When fast reaches null, slow is cnt links from null.

why.zh: 同步前进保持距离 cnt 不变。空位置是最后一个节点之后的位置，所以从 slow 再走 cnt 条边到空，等价于 slow 是倒数第 cnt 个节点。题目保证 1≤cnt≤链长，提前行走合法。
why.en: Synchronous movement preserves the cnt-link gap. Null is the position after the final node, so being cnt links before it is exactly the cnt-th node from the end. The guaranteed cnt range makes the initial advance valid.

trace.zh:
head=2→4→7→8，cnt=2。
1. fast 先走两步到节点 7，slow 仍为 2。
2. 同步走到 (slow=4,fast=8)，再到 (slow=7,fast=nil)。
3. 返回原节点 7，后缀仍为 7→8。
trace.en:
head=2→4→7→8, cnt=2.
1. Fast advances to seven while slow stays at two.
2. Move to (four,eight), then (seven,null).
3. Return the original seven node with its 7→8 suffix intact.

mapping.zh: 链表已排序，相同值必然相邻。保留每段的第一个节点，若后继同值就跳过，否则前进到下一段。
mapping.en: Sorted order makes equal values adjacent. Keep the first node in each run, bypass equal successors, and advance when the value changes.

why.zh: cur 之前的各段都已经恰留一项，cur 是当前段的第一个保留节点。跳过同值后继只删除重复项，不前进可继续处理任意长重复段；遇到不同值时当前段已清理完，可以安全前进。
why.en: Before cur, every run already has one retained node, and cur is the first retained node of its run. Bypassing equal successors removes only duplicates; staying in place handles runs of any length. A differing successor marks the next run.

trace.zh:
head=1→1→1→2→3→3。
1. cur 留在第一个 1，连续跳过后面两个 1。
2. 走到 2，再走到第一个 3。
3. 跳过第二个 3，返回 1→2→3。
trace.en:
head=1→1→1→2→3→3.
1. Stay on the first one and bypass both duplicate ones.
2. Advance through two to the first three.
3. Bypass the duplicate three and return 1→2→3.

mapping.zh: 首尾字符需要交换，然后同样处理去掉两端的内部区间。两个指针相向移动即可原地完成，无需创建倒序副本。
mapping.en: Swap the outer characters, then repeat on the inner interval. Two inward-moving pointers reverse the array in place without another buffer.

why.zh: 每轮之前，区间外的字符已处于最终对称位置，区间内字符尚未处理。交换把两端放到正确位置，缩小区间保持不变量。每对对称位置只交换一次，中间单字符无需操作。
why.en: Before each round, outside characters occupy their final mirrored positions and the inner interval remains unprocessed. Swapping places both endpoints correctly and preserves the invariant on a smaller interval. Each mirrored pair is handled once.

trace.zh:
s=[h,e,l,l,o]。
1. 交换首尾，得到 [o,e,l,l,h]。
2. 交换下标 1、3，得到 [o,l,l,e,h]。
3. 两指针都到下标 2，停止；无需返回新切片。
trace.en:
s=[h,e,l,l,o].
1. Swap endpoints to get [o,e,l,l,h].
2. Swap indices one and three to get [o,l,l,e,h].

mapping.zh: 从 1..9 选 k 个不同数，和为 n。用递增的下一候选 start 保证不重复使用数字，也不生成同一组合的不同排列。
mapping.en: Choose k distinct digits from one through nine summing to n. An increasing next-candidate start prevents both reuse and reordered duplicates.

why.zh: 任意合法组合排序后有唯一递增选择顺序，递归完整枚举这条路径且不产生其他排列。每次剩余数量减一、剩余和减当前值，终点精确检查两个约束；正数与候选数量剪枝只排除不可能成功的分支。
why.en: Every valid combination has one increasing selection order, included exactly once by recursion. Each step reduces count and sum, and the terminal check enforces both constraints. Positive-value and candidate-count pruning removes only impossible branches.

trace.en:
k=3, n=9.
1. Start with one, then two and six: [1,2,6].
2. Use three and five after one: [1,3,5].
3. Starting with two gives [2,3,4], without reordered duplicates.

mapping.zh: 这一题的每个候选位置只可使用一次，但相同值可在输入中多次出现。先按值排序，用递增下标防重复使用，用同层去重防重复答案。
mapping.en: Each candidate position is usable once, while equal values may occupy multiple positions. Sort values, increase indices to prevent reuse and skip equal siblings to avoid duplicate answers.

why.zh: 对任一值组合，把相同值依次分配给最靠前的可用下标，得到一条保留路径，因此同层去重不漏答案。任何两条保留路径若首个不同选择同值，后者本应被跳过，所以也不会重复。跨层仍可使用第二个相同值，正确保留多重选择。
why.en: Assign each value combination to its earliest available equal indices to obtain a retained path, proving completeness. Two retained paths cannot first differ by equal siblings because the later one would be skipped. Equal values remain selectable at deeper levels, preserving multiplicity.

trace.zh:
candidates=[2,5,2,1,2]、target=5。
1. 排序为 [1,2,2,2,5]。
2. 选择 1 后可跨层选两个 2，得到 [1,2,2]。
3. 根层同值的 2 不重复开分支；另有单项 [5]，共两组。
trace.en:
candidates=[2,5,2,1,2], target=5.
1. Sort into [1,2,2,2,5].
2. After one, choose two twos at successive depths to get [1,2,2].
3. Skip equal sibling branches; the other answer is [5].

mapping.zh: 排列要求每个输入位置用一次；值相同时交换身份不会产生新排列。排序后规定同值元素按下标顺序使用，为每个值排列保留唯一身份表示。
mapping.en: A permutation uses every input position once, but exchanging identities of equal values creates no new output. Sort and enforce index order among equals to retain one representation per value permutation.

why.zh: 任意值排列都能把第一个某值分配给它的第一份副本、第二个分配给第二份，恰好满足顺序约束，故不漏解。同值身份顺序唯一，消除了全部只交换同值身份的重复。used 在回溯时恢复，其他排列仍可使用该位置。
why.en: Assign successive occurrences of each value to successive sorted copies; every value permutation satisfies the rule and remains reachable. That identity assignment is unique, eliminating duplicate outputs. Restoring used during backtracking leaves positions available for other permutations.

nums=[1,1,2]。

2. 第一份已用后，下一层允许第二个 1，得到 [1,1,2]。
3. 另外得到 [1,2,1]、[2,1,1]，共三种。

2. Once it is used, the second is allowed deeper, producing [1,1,2].

mapping.zh: 有序数组中目标成绩形成连续区间。分别找第一个≥target 和第一个>target 的位置，两个边界之差就是出现次数。
mapping.en: In sorted scores, all target occurrences form one interval. Its size is the first >target position minus the first ≥target position.

why.zh: 排序保证每个边界对应 false→true 的单调分界。二分每次保留第一个 true 的可能位置，终止时得到精确边界。两界之间所有值都等于目标，界外均不等，因此差值就是个数。
why.en: Sorted order gives a false-to-true predicate boundary for each search. Binary search preserves the first possible true position and ends at the exact bound. Values between the bounds are precisely the target occurrences.

trace.zh:
scores=[2,2,3,4,4,4,5,6,6,8]、target=4。
1. 首个≥4 的位置为下标 3。
2. 首个>4 的位置为下标 6。
3. 返回 6-3=3；target=7 时两界都为 9，返回 0。

mapping.zh: 把四重枚举拆成两组配对，哈希键为 A+B，值为这种和出现的次数。
mapping.en: Split four-way enumeration into two pair groups; map A+B to its multiplicity.

why.zh: 每个四元组唯一分成一对 A、B 与一对 C、D；加上互为相反数的频次就精确统计所有下标组合。
why.en: Each quadruple uniquely splits into the two pair groups, so opposite-sum multiplicities count every index combination exactly once.

trace.zh:
A=[1,2]、B=[-2,-1]、C=[-1,2]、D=[0,2]。
1. 统计 A+B：和 -1 出现一次，0 出现两次，1 出现一次。
2. 枚举 C+D 得到 -1 时，需要另一侧和为 1，贡献一组。
3. 枚举得到 1 时，需要和为 -1，再贡献一组；其余组合贡献为 0，答案为 2。

mapping.zh: 逐格执行每次区间加法会重复扫描。区间 [l,r] 加 v，只会改变差分的两处：l 增 v，r+1 减 v，最后累计即可还原数组。
mapping.en: Updating every covered cell repeats work. Adding v on [l,r] changes only two difference boundaries: +v at l and -v at r+1; a final prefix sum reconstructs values.

why.zh: 单次更新的前缀累计在 l 前为 0、l..r 为 v、r 后回到 0，精确等于目标区间增量。多次更新可逐项叠加，累计和的线性性保证最终每格恰收到覆盖它的所有增量。
why.en: One boundary pair contributes zero before l, v through r and zero afterward. Summing such pairs and then taking prefixes adds exactly the updates covering each cell.

trace.en:
length=5, updates=[[1,3,2],[2,4,3],[0,2,-2]].
1. The first two updates produce [0,2,3,0,-2,-3].
2. The final update gives [-2,2,3,2,-2,-3].
3. Prefix-sum the first five positions to get [-2,0,3,5,3].

mapping.zh: 每条预订给连续航班统一增加座位，正是区间加法。航班编号从 1 开始，先换成零基边界，最后一次累计还原。
mapping.en: Each booking uniformly adds seats to a consecutive flight range. Convert one-based flight numbers into difference boundaries and reconstruct once.

why.zh: 一次预订的两个边界让座位增量从首航班开始生效，在末航班之后停止。所有预订增量独立相加，累计值就是当前航班被所有覆盖预订贡献的座位数。
why.en: Each boundary pair activates seats at the first flight and deactivates them after the last. Summing independent bookings makes each prefix equal the seats contributed to that flight.

1. Add ten at index zero and cancel at two.
2. Add twenty and twenty-five at one, canceling at three and five.

mapping.zh: 一次行程在 [from,to) 占用座位，from 上车、to 下车。把上下车人数记录成位置事件，沿道路累计检查容量。
mapping.en: A trip occupies seats on [from,to): passengers board at from and leave at to. Accumulate position events to check capacity along the road.

why.zh: 相邻事件之间没有乘客变化，因此只需检查事件位置。半开区间让在某位置下车的人不再占用从该点出发的路段；同点事件合并后再比较容量，正好体现先下后上可复用座位。
why.en: Occupancy is constant between event positions. Half-open intervals release seats exactly at drop-off; combining same-position changes before checking capacity correctly reuses seats for new passengers.

3. 到位置 7 全部下车，始终不超载，返回 true。

Trips [[2,1,5],[3,5,7]], capacity=3.

2. At five, two leave and three board, giving occupancy three.

mapping.zh: 环形数组可以逻辑上扫描两圈，让第一圈末尾也能看到开头。单调栈保存尚未找到严格更大后继的原下标，只在第一圈入栈。
mapping.en: Scan two logical laps so trailing elements can see the beginning. A monotone stack holds unresolved original indices, pushed only during the first lap.

why.zh: 每个下标入栈一次，候选值从栈底到栈顶不增。弹出时，当前是按环形次序遇到的首个更大值，之前都不足以弹出它，所以答案最早。两圈覆盖所有不足 n 步的后继，额外遇到自身或相等值不会误匹配。
why.en: Each index is pushed once in nonincreasing value order. A popped index has met its first greater value in circular order, since earlier values could not resolve it. Two laps cover every possible successor within n steps, while equality cannot create a false match.

trace.zh:
nums=[1,2,1]。
1. 第一圈读到 2，解决下标 0 的 1，答案为 2。
2. 第二圈经过开头再到 2，解决末尾下标 2 的 1。
3. 最大值 2 没有更大后继，返回 [2,-1,2]。
trace.en:
nums=[1,2,1].
1. First-lap two resolves index zero.
2. The second lap’s two resolves the trailing one.
3. Two has no greater successor, giving [2,-1,2].

mapping.zh: 每一天都在等右侧第一天更暖的气温。保存尚未解决的日期下标，遇到较高温度就一次解决多个较冷候选。
mapping.en: Each day waits for its first warmer future day. Store unresolved day indices and let a warmer arrival resolve all smaller temperatures at the top.

why.zh: 栈中日期递增、温度不增。某日 j 被当前日 i 弹出之前，没有更早暖日曾经过，否则它已经出栈。因此 i 恰是首个更暖日。每天下标最多入栈出栈各一次。
why.en: Indices increase and temperatures do not increase within the stack. If an earlier warmer day existed, j would already have been removed; thus the popping day is its first warmer successor. Each day enters and leaves at most once.

trace.zh:
temperatures=[30,40,40,50]。
1. 日期 1 的 40 解决日期 0，等待为 1。
2. 日期 2 的 40 不严格更暖，两个 40 都留在栈中。
3. 日期 3 的 50 分别解决它们，等待为 2、1，答案 [1,2,1,0]。
trace.en:
temperatures=[30,40,40,50].
1. Day one resolves thirty with wait one.
2. Equal forty on day two resolves neither forty.
3. Fifty resolves them with waits two and one, producing [1,2,1,0].

mapping.zh: 普通队列保存商品的真实先后顺序，另一条不增队列只保存仍可能成为最大值的候选。新商品更晚离开，会支配它之前更便宜的尾部候选。
mapping.en: One queue preserves actual item order; a nonincreasing candidate deque retains possible maxima. A later, more expensive item outlives and dominates cheaper candidates before it.

why.zh: 被新值删除的较小旧值一定比新值更早出队，所以未来任何仍包含旧值的窗口也包含更大的新值，旧值不再可能决定最大值。其余候选保持顺序与不增性，队首即最大值。每项最多进入、离开各队列一次，故更新均摊常数。
why.en: A dominated older item leaves before the newer larger one, so whenever it remains present the newer value also remains and is larger. Remaining candidates preserve order and nonincreasing values, making the front maximal. Each item enters and leaves each queue once, giving amortized constant updates.

依次 Add(4)、Add(7)、Add(7)。
1. 真实队列为 [4,7,7]，候选为 [7,7]，两个相等最大值都保留。
2. Remove 返回 4，候选不变；再 Remove 返回第一个 7，只删一个候选 7。
3. Get_max 仍为 7，最后一次 Remove 后为空，再查最大值返回 -1。

Add four, seven, seven.
1. The real queue is [4,7,7], candidates [7,7].
2. Removing four leaves candidates unchanged; removing the first seven removes only one candidate seven.
3. Maximum remains seven until the final removal, then -1.

mapping.zh: 普通前缀和查询快，但修改一个数会影响后面所有前缀。线段树把区间和分层保存，修改只更新树高那么多祖先，查询组合少量不相交节点。
mapping.en: Prefix sums answer quickly but a point change affects many prefixes. A segment tree stores hierarchical sums, recomputing ancestors on updates and combining disjoint nodes on queries.

why.zh: 父节点始终等于两个孩子之和，修改沿唯一祖先链重建此不变量。查询时，左边界是右孩子就单独取它，右边界跨出的左孩子同理取出；剩余部分可整块上移。收集节点互不重叠，且并集恰好是目标区间。
why.en: Every parent equals its children’s sum; a point update restores this along its sole ancestor chain. Query boundary nodes that cannot be lifted together are collected, and the remaining interval ascends intact. Collected ranges are disjoint and cover exactly the requested interval.

nums=[1,3,5]。

2. Update(1,2) 把中间值从 3 改为 2，同时重算其祖先。
3. SumRange(0,2)=8，SumRange(1,1)=2；这不是给原值再加 2。

nums=[1,3,5].

2. Update(1,2) replaces three with two and rebuilds ancestors.
3. The full sum becomes eight and the single-cell sum two.

mapping.zh: 只有加减与括号时，当前层只需保存已累计结果、待用符号和正在读取的数。括号进入新上下文，闭合时把整层结果作为外层的一个操作数。
mapping.en: With addition, subtraction and parentheses, each level needs an accumulated result, a pending sign and the current number. A closed parenthesis becomes one operand in its outer context.

why.zh: 当前层已完成项之和始终在 result 中，尚未结束的数字在 number 中。括号栈完整保存暂停的外层计算；闭合后将整段子表达式代回，等价于先计算括号。开头或左括号后的负号作用于初始零项，不需要特殊伪造数字。
why.en: result stores completed terms at the current level and number stores the unfinished literal. The stack preserves each suspended outer context, so closing a parenthesis performs exact substitution. Unary minus at a context start changes the sign after a zero term.

2. 内层计算 2-3=-1。
3. 闭合后得到 1+(-1)×(-1)=2，返回 2；-(2+3) 同样得到 -5。
trace.en:
s=1-(2-3).
1. Save outer result one and sign minus one.
2. The inner result is -1.
3. Combine as 1+(-1)×(-1)=2; -(2+3) similarly gives -5.

mapping.zh: 先把表达式按加减分成若干带符号乘除项。total 保存已经完成的项，last 保存当前乘除项，遇到乘除就立即折叠到 last。
mapping.en: Treat the expression as signed multiplication/division terms. total stores completed terms, while last holds the current term and immediately folds multiplication or division.

why.zh: 加减尚未遇到下一低优先级运算符前，当前项的乘除还可能继续，因此只暂存在 last。乘除左到右立即折叠，保持左结合；加减只连接已经完整的项，优先级自然正确。Go 整数除法向零截断，符合题意。
why.en: The current term may continue through more multiplication/division, so it remains in last until the next low-precedence boundary. Folding */ immediately preserves left associativity; adding only completed terms preserves precedence. Go integer division truncates toward zero.

3. 除以 2 后 last=-1，按向零截断得到结果 14-1=13。
trace.en:
s=14-3/2.

mapping.zh: 把优先级写进语法层次：表达式由加减项组成，项由乘除因子组成，因子是数字、括号表达式或带一元符号的因子。每层只消费属于自己的运算符。
mapping.en: Encode precedence in grammar: expressions combine additive terms, terms combine multiplicative factors, and factors are numbers, parenthesized expressions or unary-signed factors. Each parser consumes only its own operators.

why.zh: factor 返回一个完整原子；term 在其上左到右折叠高优先级运算；expression 再连接完整项。括号递归重新进入 expression，因此括号内部被优先整体求值。按这三个定义归纳，每层结果与合法表达式的语义一致。
why.en: factor returns one complete atom. term folds high-precedence operations left-to-right, then expression combines complete terms. Parentheses recursively restart expression parsing, proving correctness by induction over the grammar.

mapping.zh: 把两组成员标为 +1、-1，每条边要求端点异色。沿图传播颜色，一条同色边就能证明这些约束无法同时满足。
mapping.en: Represent the two groups by +1 and -1. Every edge requires opposite colors, propagated through the graph; a same-color edge proves a contradiction.

why.zh: 在一个连通分量内，选定起点颜色后，沿任一路径的奇偶性决定颜色。若出现同色边，两条传播路径加该边构成奇偶矛盾；若没有冲突，每条边都已检查异色，得到的颜色就是合法二分划分。
why.en: Once a component root is colored, path parity determines colors. A same-color edge contradicts these parity requirements. Without conflicts every edge has opposite endpoints, so the constructed colors themselves form a valid bipartition.

3. 2 与 3 的颜色相反，所有边通过；三角形则必出现同色边。

2. Vertex two becomes +1.
3. Its edge to three is consistent; a triangle would force a conflict.

mapping.zh: 把“互不喜欢”看成无向边，两组分配就是二分图着色。输入人员编号为 1..n，建立无向邻接表后逐分量染色。
mapping.en: Model dislikes as undirected edges; assigning two groups is bipartite coloring. Build a graph for one-based people and color each component.

why.zh: 每条无向边就是一条异组约束，两色传播逐条满足它。无冲突时两种颜色对应的人员集合直接构成解；冲突时同一人员被路径奇偶要求放入两组，故无解。
why.en: Each edge is exactly an opposite-group constraint. Conflict-free coloring explicitly supplies two valid groups; a conflict forces one person into both groups by inconsistent path parity.

3. Groups {1,4} and {2,3} satisfy every dislike.

mapping.zh: 沿边给相反颜色，就是在验证是否能将所有顶点分成两组且边只跨组。环长为奇数时，相反颜色绕一圈会和起点矛盾。
mapping.en: Opposite-color propagation checks whether all edges can cross two groups. An odd cycle returns to its start with a contradictory required color.

why.zh: BFS 树固定了各节点相对根的层数奇偶。每条非树边再检查这一奇偶约束；一旦冲突，颜色整体翻转也不能修复。全部边通过时，按最终颜色分组就是所求划分。
why.en: The BFS tree fixes each vertex’s parity relative to the root. Non-tree edges check that parity too; flipping all colors cannot repair a same-color edge. Passing every edge yields the required partition.

trace.en:

2. Starting at one gives two and three the same opposite color.
3. Edge two-three conflicts, so the entire graph is not bipartite.

mapping.zh: 无向树要求连通且无环。n 个节点的树恰有 n-1 条边；先检查边数，再用并查集确认每条边连接不同分量。
mapping.en: An undirected tree is connected and acyclic with exactly n-1 edges. Check the edge count, then ensure every edge merges distinct components.

why.zh: 每次成功合并把分量数减少 1。起初 n 个分量，n-1 条边若均未成环，就恰好剩一个分量，得到连通无环图；反之树中任何一条边都不会连接已有路径的两端。
why.en: Each successful merge reduces the component count by one. Starting with n, n-1 non-cycling edges leave exactly one component, proving connectivity and acyclicity. Conversely a tree edge cannot close an existing path.

3. 每次都连接不同分量，最终全连通，返回 true。

2. The first three join zero through three; the last adds four.
3. Every merge joins distinct components, yielding a tree.

mapping.zh: 目标是所有城市总体连接费用最低，不是从某个起点出发距离最短。按价格从小到大尝试边，只在连接不同分量时选取，得到 Kruskal 最小生成树。
mapping.en: Minimize total cost of connecting all cities rather than distances from one source. Kruskal considers edges by increasing cost and selects only those joining different components.

why.zh: 当前最便宜的跨分量边横跨一个割。任意完成连接的生成树都需跨越这个割；用该边替换树中相应跨割边不会增加费用。因此每次选择都能扩展成某棵最优树，直到覆盖所有城市。
why.en: The cheapest available cross-component edge crosses a cut. Every spanning tree must cross that cut, and replacing its crossing edge by this cheapest one cannot increase cost. Each choice remains extendable to an optimal tree.

3. 已有两条边，返回 6；费用 6 的 1—3 会成环，无需选择。
trace.en:

1. Select two-three at cost one.
2. Select one-two at cost five.
3. All cities are connected at cost six; the remaining edge would close a cycle.

mapping.zh: 每两个点都可相连，费用为曼哈顿距离，构成隐式完全图。用稠密 Prim 维护每个未选点到已选集合的最低连边费用，避免存储所有平方级边。
mapping.en: Every pair has a Manhattan-distance edge, forming an implicit complete graph. Dense Prim tracks each unused point’s cheapest edge to the selected set without storing all quadratic edges.

why.zh: best 总是记录每个未选点到已选集合的最便宜边，因此最小 best 就是当前割的最小边。割的交换论证保证加入它不会排除最优生成树。每轮只加入一个新点，最终 n-1 条实际连边构成全局最优连接。
why.en: best stores the cheapest edge from the selected set to each unused point. The minimum is a cheapest crossing edge, safe by the cut exchange argument. Adding one new point per round ultimately forms an optimal spanning tree.

3. Add [3,10] at cost nine, totaling twenty.

mapping.zh: 每个城市都要统计阈值内能到达多少其他城市，适合一次计算所有点对最短路。Floyd 按允许的中转点逐层扩展可行路径。
mapping.en: Every city needs the count of other cities reachable within a threshold. Compute all-pairs shortest paths by progressively allowing intermediate vertices with Floyd’s algorithm.

why.zh: 允许中转点到 k 时，最短路径要么不经过 k，要么拆为 i→k 与 k→j，两段此前已求得。正权保证超过阈值的距离不会通过后续延伸变得更短到阈值内，所以饱和不会影响计数。最终逐城比较规则直接实现题目的两级排序。
why.en: A shortest path allowing intermediates through k either avoids k or splits into previously solved i→k and k→j parts. Positive weights make capping above-threshold distances safe for reachability counts. The final comparison enforces count first, greatest ID second.

3. Zero and three tie, so return three.

mapping.zh: 先按宽度升序；相同宽度按高度降序。再对高度求严格递增子序列，这样同宽信封不会被错误串进同一套娃链。
mapping.en: Sort widths ascending and equal-width heights descending, then find a strictly increasing subsequence of heights. Descending ties prevent equal-width envelopes from nesting.

why.zh: 宽度不同且递增时，只需高度严格递增。相同宽度的高度降序，任何严格递增高度子序列最多取其中一个，所以一维链恰对应合法二维链。替换同长度的更小末尾不损失已有长度，只扩大后续可接范围。
why.en: For increasing distinct widths only increasing heights remain necessary. Descending heights within equal widths allow at most one such envelope in a strict height subsequence. Keeping the smallest ending height preserves the length while maximizing extension opportunities.

mapping.zh: 到当前格的最小代价只来自上一行同列、左上、右上三个位置。按行填表，第一行每格都可以直接作为路径起点。
mapping.en: The minimum cost to a cell comes from the previous row’s same or adjacent columns. Fill row by row, allowing every first-row cell as a start.

why.zh: 第一行的最优代价就是自身值。任意到当前格的合法路径都有且仅有三类上一步，取这些最优前缀中的最小者即可；使用新行数组避免一边更新一边读取已被覆盖的前驱。
why.en: First-row optima equal their values. Every later path enters from one of the valid three predecessors, so minimizing their optimal prefixes is exact. A fresh row preserves all previous-row dependencies.

mapping.zh: dp[j] 表示已扫描源串中有多少种按下标选择的子序列等于目标前 j 项。字符相等时，可跳过当前源字符，也可用它接到旧 dp[j-1] 后。

why.zh: 每个匹配子序列要么不使用当前源下标，要么使用它作最后一项，两类不交叠，所以相加。倒序确保当前下标只用一次。非负计数满足 min(C,a+b)=min(C,min(C,a)+min(C,b))，饱和递推始终等于真实计数截到 C；最终答案≤C，故仍精确。
why.en: Matches split disjointly into those omitting the current source index and those using it as the final item. Backward updates prevent reuse. For nonnegative counts, clamping commutes with addition, so every state equals the true count capped at C; the promised final count≤C remains exact.

mapping.zh: 先枚举第一个单词的结束位置，剩余后缀独立递归。缓存每个后缀的全部句子，最后把当前单词接到每个有效后缀句子前。

why.zh: 任何合法句子都有唯一的第一个切点，枚举所有字典前缀即可覆盖。剩余句子完全来自后缀子问题，前缀拼接与切点一一对应，不会把不同分词合并丢失。记忆化复用后缀结果，不改变枚举集合。
why.en: Every valid sentence has a unique first cut. All its remaining words form a valid suffix sentence, so combining every dictionary prefix with every valid suffix is complete and nonduplicating. Memoization reuses results without altering that set.

mapping.zh: 两个前缀要通过删除变成相同。末字符相等时一起保留；不等时至少删掉一侧末字符，比较两种删除代价。
mapping.en: Make two prefixes equal using deletions only. Equal final characters can remain together; otherwise delete at least one side’s final character and minimize the two options.

why.zh: 失配末字符不可能同时留在相同结果末尾，故至少删除其中一个，两种选择完整覆盖。相等时保留这对末字符可在共同子序列中使用它们，不增加删除数。等价地答案为两串总长减去两倍 LCS 长度。
why.en: Mismatching final characters cannot both survive as the common final character, so deleting either covers all possibilities. Equal ends may be retained in a common subsequence. Equivalently the result is total length minus twice the LCS length.

why.en: A mismatch forces deletion from at least one side, with its ASCII weight plus the reduced-prefix optimum. Matching ends can be kept at no cost; positive weights make that safe. Induction over prefixes yields the minimum total.

mapping.en: Compare interval ends: equal ends need no insertion and reduce to the interior; otherwise copy either end to the opposite side and take the cheaper option.

why.zh: 相等两端可一起作为回文外壳，不会影响内部最优；不等两端不能直接配对，至少需要补一个端点对应字符。选择补哪侧后，剩下恰是删除相应端点的原区间子问题，两种情况覆盖所有最优构造。
why.en: Equal ends can form the palindrome shell around an optimal interior. Unequal ends cannot pair directly, requiring an inserted copy of at least one end. Each choice reduces to one shorter interval, covering optimal constructions.

mapping.zh: 设加正号的子集和为 P，全部元素总和为 S，则 P-(S-P)=target，所以 P=(S+target)/2。问题转成按下标选择的 0/1 子集计数。
mapping.en: Let positive-signed indices sum to P and all values sum to S. Then P-(S-P)=target, so P=(S+target)/2: count zero-one subsets by index.

why.zh: 每个符号分配唯一对应“选哪些下标加正号”，方程保证与目标值等价。倒序 0/1 计数不重复使用同一下标；零的正负号虽不改变和，仍是不同分配，因此翻倍恰好正确。
why.en: Every sign assignment uniquely chooses the positive index set, and the equation enforces exactly the target. Backward updates use each index once. Zero’s two signs are distinct assignments even though their sums coincide, correctly doubling counts.

mapping.en: dp[i][j] means the first i text characters completely match the first j pattern characters. A literal/dot consumes one each; star binds its preceding atom and matches zero or another occurrence.

why.zh: 不带星号的末项若匹配，就只剩更短的两个前缀。带星号时，合法匹配要么使用该项零次，要么至少一次；消费最后一次后仍允许该星号继续作用，因此保留模式长度 j。两分支取或完整覆盖全部可能。
why.en: Without star, a matching final atom leaves two shorter prefixes. With star, a valid match uses its atom zero times or at least once; consuming one occurrence keeps the same pattern prefix for further repeats. Their disjunction covers all matches.

mapping.zh: 不用分别保存两人的总分，直接保存当前行动者能领先对手多少。取左堆后，对手成为剩余区间行动者，所以净优势为左值减去对手最优优势。
mapping.en: Store the current player’s lead rather than both totals. After taking the left pile, the opponent becomes the remaining interval’s current player, so subtract that optimal lead from the taken value.

why.zh: 双方得分总和固定，当前玩家最大化自身得分等价于最大化与对手的分差。取一端后回合交换，剩余区间分差的含义正好反向，所以要减去它。枚举两端并让对手取其最优值，完整表达最坏回应下的最佳选择。
why.en: With a fixed total, maximizing one’s score is equivalent to maximizing the lead. Taking an end swaps the player roles, so the remaining lead is subtracted. Considering both ends with optimal opponent responses implements minimax exactly.

why.zh: 任何回合只能取两个端点之一，回合交换后对手会最大化自己的领先分数，所以当前分差等于端点值减去对手最优分差。两个选择取最大递归覆盖全部对局；最终非负就能确保不输。
why.en: Each turn chooses one endpoint and leaves the opponent maximizing their own lead. Subtracting that optimum and maximizing the two choices covers every game. A nonnegative final lead guarantees the first player does not lose.

why.zh: 每个环形合法方案至少排除首尾之一，因此包含在两个线性问题的并集中；每个子问题内的方案又都满足环形约束。对这两个完整候选集合取最大即可，重复出现的方案不影响求最大值。
why.en: Every circular-feasible set excludes at least one endpoint and belongs to one of the two linear cases. Each case also produces only circular-feasible sets. Maximizing their union is exact; duplicate sets do not affect a maximum.

mapping.zh: 树上相邻父子不能同时选。每个子树返回两种收益：不选根、选根，让父节点根据自身是否选择来组合孩子状态。
mapping.en: Adjacent parent/child houses cannot both be taken. Each subtree returns skip-root and take-root profits, which its parent combines according to its own choice.

why.zh: 选根就必须不选孩子，这是唯一跨子树约束；不选根时左右子树互不影响。两个状态枚举根是否选的全部可能，孩子返回相应条件下的最优值，因此后序组合得到整树最优。
why.en: Taking the root forces both child roots skipped, the only cross-subtree constraint. Without it, left and right subtrees are independent. The two root choices exhaust possibilities, and postorder optimal child states produce the whole-tree optimum.

why.en: End-of-day cash either remains cash or sells today; holding either persists or buys today. These possibilities exhaust transitions, preserving optimal states. Charging the sell branch counts each completed transaction’s fee exactly once.

mapping.en: Add a transaction-budget dimension: cash[t] is the cash optimum with at most t transactions and hold[t] its holding state. The t-th buy uses cash[t-1].

why.zh: 交易额度 t 下的空仓可延续或从旧 hold[t] 卖出；持股可延续或从额度 t-1 的旧空仓买入。这与“第 t 笔交易”的定义一致。倒序让 cash[t-1] 仍是昨天，先卖后更新 hold[t] 让卖出也只读旧值。
why.en: Cash at budget t persists or sells old hold[t]; holding persists or buys from old cash[t-1]. These transitions respect the next transaction budget. Backward budget order preserves yesterday’s lower-budget cash, and selling before updating hold preserves its old value.

why.en: The stack top is the next subtree root to visit. Placing right work beneath left work makes all left-subtree tasks finish before the right subtree, preserving the recursive root-left-right definition.

mapping.zh: BST 的有序性使祖先查找不必遍历两边：两目标值都较小就进左树，都较大就进右树，否则当前节点就是分叉点。
mapping.en: BST ordering directs both targets into one child until their paths split or one equals the current node.

why.zh: 两目标同在一侧时，最低公共祖先也在该侧，当前节点不可能最低。第一次分叉或等值时，两条查找路径首次共同停留于此，其下任何单侧都不能同时包含两目标。
why.en: When both targets lie on one side their lowest common ancestor lies there too. At the first split or equality, no descendant can contain both paths.

3. 返回节点 2。
trace.en:

2. At two, one target equals the current node.
3. Return two.

mapping.zh: 普通树逐节点计数要 O(n)。完全树可比较最左和最右高度：高度相等时它是满树，可直接用 2^h-1；否则递归子树。
mapping.en: For a complete tree, equal extreme heights identify a perfect subtree that can be counted with 2^h-1.

why.zh: 完全树的最后一层从左填充，所以极端高度相等才保证所有层都满；非满时至少一棵子树为满树，因此每层只有一支继续深递归。每层测高 O(log n)，共 O(log n) 层。
why.en: Left-filled completeness makes equal extreme heights sufficient for perfection. At least one child subtree is perfect, leaving only one deep recursive branch at each level.

3. 右子树计 2，加根得到 6。

For complete tree [1,2,3,4,5,6]:
1. Extreme heights differ.
2. Count the perfect left subtree as three.
3. Count two on the right and add the root, giving six.

mapping.zh: 把大排序拆成两个小排序，最后线性合并。采用自底向上归并，宽度从 1 倍增，避免依赖递归调用栈。
mapping.en: Sort increasingly wide runs and merge adjacent sorted runs bottom-up.

why.zh: 宽度为 1 的段天然有序；若本轮输入段各有序，每次取最小头部能得到有序并集。归纳可知宽度覆盖 n 后全数组有序。每轮扫描 n 个元素，共向上取整 log n 轮。
why.en: Singleton runs are sorted. Merging sorted runs by their smallest heads preserves order, so doubling eventually yields one sorted array.

trace.en:
For [5,1,4,2,3]:
1. Width one yields [1,5,2,4,3].
2. Width two sorts the first four.
3. Width four merges the final three into place.

mapping.zh: 答案属于原下标，排序时应搬动下标而非丢失位置。归并两段时，先取出的右段元素都严格小于当前左段元素，可累计到它的答案。
mapping.en: Merge indices instead of values. Right elements already emitted are strictly smaller than the current left element.

why.zh: 每对满足 i<j 的下标在某次归并中首次分属左右两半，此时且仅此时计数。右段有序，已经输出的右值全都严格较小；相等先取左排除了不应计数的重复值。
why.en: Each index pair is separated at exactly one merge level. The emitted right prefix contains precisely the strictly smaller right values, and left-first ties exclude equal values.

3. 右半内部 6 大于 1，最终 [2,1,1,0]。

For [5,2,6,1]:
1. Two contributes one to five within the left half.
2. One contributes to both left values during the final merge.
3. Six gets one internally, yielding [2,1,1,0].

mapping.zh: 普通逆序计数比较 a>b，这里条件是 a>2b，不能直接照搬归并时的移动次数。两段有序后，先用独立指针计数，再正常归并。

why.zh: 排序后左值递增，满足不等式的右侧前缀只会扩大，指针无需回退。内部计数与跨段计数覆盖所有下标对且互不重叠；比较使用 int64 防止两倍溢出。
why.en: Increasing left values make the qualifying right prefix monotone. Internal and cross counts partition all index pairs; widened multiplication preserves the intended inequality.

2. 跨段中，左侧 3 与右侧 1 满足 3>2。
3. 合计两个满足条件的下标对，返回 2。
trace.en:
For [1,3,2,3,1]:
1. Count internal pairs recursively.
2. A left three and right one satisfy the cross condition.
3. The total is two.

mapping.zh: 把子数组和改写成 prefix[j]-prefix[i]，i<j。分治保留下标先后关系，两段排序后用两个单调边界统计差值落在闭区间的数量。

why.zh: 左右划分基于原前缀下标，因此跨段天然满足 i<j。排序不改变可选值及其重数。左值递增时，两阈值都递增，边界单向推进；每对子数组端点只在一个分治层计数。
why.en: The original index split ensures i<j for cross pairs. Sorting preserves multiplicities, thresholds move monotonically, and each pair is counted at one merge level.

mapping.zh: LFU 要先淘汰使用次数最少的键，同频时再淘汰最久未使用者。单链表不够，需要哈希定位记录、按频次分桶，并在每桶维护 LRU 顺序。
mapping.en: LFU evicts the least frequent key and breaks ties by recency. Combine an entry map, frequency buckets and a recency list within each bucket.

why.zh: 哈希定位让访问无需扫描；每次使用只增加一次频次，所以空的最小桶被移走后，新最小值就是刚进入的 f+1。桶内把最近访问移到前端，使桶尾恰为同频 LRU。新键插入总会令最小频次回到 1。
why.en: Hash lookup avoids scans. A promoted minimum-frequency entry moves to exactly f+1, making that the new minimum when its old bucket empties. Front insertion maintains recency order within each bucket.

容量 2：Put(1,10)、Put(2,20)、Get(1)、Put(3,30)。

3. 插入 3 淘汰频次 1 的键 2，键 1 保留。
trace.en:
With capacity two, insert keys one and two, access one, then insert three.
1. Both keys start at frequency one.
2. Access promotes one to frequency two.
3. Three evicts key two.

mapping.zh: 逐行放皇后时，已占列和两种对角线决定本行能放的位置。位掩码一次列出可选列，递归只计算完整方案数量。
mapping.en: Place one queen per row, tracking attacked columns and diagonals with bit masks.

why.zh: 递归每层固定一行且只选未被攻击的列，所以所有叶子合法。任何合法棋盘在各行选择唯一列，都会沿相应分支到达，因而不重不漏。位移正确表达下一行的两条对角线攻击。
why.en: Each row chooses one unattacked column, so every completed branch is valid. Every valid board has exactly one row-by-row path, giving a bijection with counted leaves.

mapping.zh: 0 是陆地、1 是水，与常见岛屿题相反。遍历每个零连通块，同时记录是否接触边界；不接触边界的块才封闭。

why.zh: 水把不同零连通块隔开，BFS 恰覆盖一个完整陆地块。一个块与棋盘外连通当且仅当它包含边界格，所以该标记精确判定封闭性。
why.en: BFS partitions land into complete components. Such a component reaches outside exactly when it contains a boundary cell.

3. 该块贡献 1；若把 (0,1) 改为 0，它连到边界，贡献变为 0。

For a two-cell zero island surrounded by ones:
1. BFS visits both cells.
2. Neither touches the boundary.
3. Count one; connecting a zero above it to the edge makes it open.

3. Count the three interior cells.

mapping.zh: grid2 的一个完整岛屿必须每格都落在 grid1 的陆地上，才是子岛。按 grid2 的连通块遍历，并对块内所有对应位置做与判断。

2. Every cell passes containment.

2. Five stands alone and four pairs with one.
3. Two copies of three-plus-two fill the remaining buckets.

mapping.zh: 区间按起点升序、同起点终点降序排序后，当前区间只需与已见最远终点比较：终点不超过它就已被覆盖。
mapping.en: Sort starts ascending and tied ends descending; an interval is covered when its end does not exceed the farthest previous end.

why.zh: 之前所有起点都不大于当前起点；若有终点达到当前终点，就存在一个之前区间覆盖它。若当前终点更远，之前没有区间能覆盖它，后续起点更大也不能覆盖它的左端。
why.en: Earlier starts are no greater. A previously reached end covering the current end therefore proves containment. A new farthest end cannot be covered by an earlier interval or by a later-starting one.

trace.en:
Sort [[1,4],[3,6],[2,8]] into start order.
1. Retain [1,4].
2. Retain [2,8].
3. Drop [3,6], leaving two.

mapping.zh: 两组区间都已排序且组内不相交。当前两段的交集可直接由较大起点和较小终点得到；先结束的那段已不可能与更晚区间产生新交集。
mapping.en: Each list is sorted and internally disjoint. Intersect the current pair and advance the interval that ends first.

why.zh: 已结束较早的区间，其终点早于另一组当前段的终点，更早于该组后续段起点，因此后续再无交集。每次安全丢弃一段，能线性枚举所有交集。
why.en: The earlier-ending interval cannot overlap any later interval of the other list. Discarding it is safe, and each interval is advanced once.

trace.en:
For A=[[1,5],[8,10]] and B=[[3,8]]:
1. Emit [3,5] and advance A.
2. Emit the endpoint intersection [8,8].
3. B finishes.

mapping.zh: 每步可拿 1..3 颗石子。先列出小规模输赢：4 无法把败局交给对手，5、6、7 可以；这个周期由模 4 决定。
mapping.en: With moves of one to three stones, losing positions repeat every four.

why.zh: 从 4 的倍数出发，任意合法步都会进入非倍数；从非倍数出发，总有一步进入倍数。以 0 为败局归纳，所有 4 的倍数都是败局，其余都是胜局。
why.en: Every move from a multiple of four reaches a nonmultiple; every nonmultiple has a move back to a multiple. Induction from zero proves the classification.

trace.zh:
n=10。
1. 10%4=2，先拿 2 颗，留 8。
2. 对手拿 x 颗，就拿 4-x 颗，使总共减少 4。
3. 保持对手面对 4 的倍数，最终自己拿到最后一颗。
trace.en:
For ten stones:
1. Remove two, leaving eight.
2. Respond to x with four-minus-x.
3. Preserve the losing class for the opponent.

nim-game.go: func canWinNim(n int) bool { return n%4 != 0 }

mapping.zh: 编号 i 的灯被它的每个正因子翻转一次。因子通常成对，只有完全平方数有一个重复配对的平方根，因此最终亮灯数就是不超过 n 的平方数个数。
mapping.en: Bulb i toggles once per positive divisor. Only perfect squares have an odd divisor count.

why.zh: 对非平方数，因子 d 与 i/d 是不同的两数，翻转抵消；平方数的平方根只出现一次，留下奇数次翻转。1²..k² 不超过 n 恰有 k=floor(sqrt(n)) 个。
why.en: Divisors pair as d and i/d. Only a square root pairs with itself, leaving an odd count. Thus there are floor(sqrt(n)) lit bulbs.

trace.zh:
n=10。
1. 编号 1、4、9 的正因子数为奇数。
2. 其他编号的因子均成不同对。
3. floor(sqrt(10))=3，最终三盏亮灯。
trace.en:
For n=10:
1. Bulbs one, four and nine have odd divisor counts.
2. Other divisor counts are even.
3. Return three.

mapping.zh: 不必逐位检查所有零：n&(n-1) 每次恰好清除最低位的 1。执行次数就是二进制中 1 的个数。
mapping.en: The operation n&(n-1) clears exactly the lowest set bit; count how often it can be applied.

why.zh: 从正整数减一会把最低的 1 变成 0，并把其右侧零变成 1；与原数相与后，右侧仍为 0，其他高位不变，所以每步恰少一个 1。
why.en: Subtracting one clears the lowest one and fills trailing zeros. AND with the original removes exactly that one while preserving higher set bits.

trace.en:
For binary 1011:
1. Clear to 1010.
2. Clear to 1000.
3. Clear to zero after three steps.

mapping.zh: 正的 2 的幂在二进制中恰好只有一个 1。因此清掉最低的 1 后若为 0，就满足条件。
mapping.en: A positive power of two has exactly one set bit.

why.zh: 每个正整数的二进制表示唯一；恰有一个置位的值必为 2^k，反之亦然。n&(n-1) 恰删最低置位，所以它为零等价于原来仅有一个置位。
why.en: Uniqueness of binary representation makes a single set bit equivalent to 2^k. Clearing one bit leaves zero exactly in that case.

trace.zh:
比较 16、12 与 0。
1. n=16 为 10000，n-1 为 01111，相与为 0，返回 true。
2. n=12 为 1100，相与后为 1000，仍有置位，返回 false。
3. n=0 需先通过正数检查排除，因为 0 不是 2 的幂。
trace.en:
Compare sixteen, twelve and zero.
1. Sixteen has one set bit; clearing it gives zero.
2. Twelve retains a set bit and fails.
3. Zero fails the explicit positivity check.

mapping.zh: 完整集合 0..n 与输入集合只差一个数。把两者所有值异或，出现两次的值抵消，只剩缺失值。
mapping.en: XOR the full range 0..n with the input; all paired values cancel.

why.zh: 异或满足交换结合律，x^x=0。初始 n 加所有下标构成 0..n，各已出现值都被输入抵消，唯一没成对的值就是缺失数字。
why.en: XOR is associative and commutative, and x^x=0. The initialization plus indices covers the full range, leaving exactly the absent value.

trace.en:
For [3,0,1]:
1. Full range is zero through three.
2. Three, zero and one cancel.
3. Two remains.

checks: func()bool{for n:=1;n<=100;n++{for absent:=0;absent<=n;absent++{a:=[]int{};for v:=n;v>=0;v--{if v!=absent{a=append(a,v)}};if missingNumber(a)!=absent{return false}}};return true}()

mapping.zh: 保存一份独立原数组，重置返回副本；洗牌使用 Fisher–Yates：从后往前，为当前末位均匀挑选剩余位置中的一个。
mapping.en: Keep an independent original snapshot and shuffle with Fisher–Yates by selecting each final position uniformly.

why.zh: 最后一位等概率取到 n 个元素之一，固定后倒数第二位从剩余 n-1 个中均匀选择，依此类推。每个排列对应唯一选择序列，概率为 1/n!。返回副本确保外部修改不污染重置快照。
why.en: Each final slot chooses uniformly from remaining elements. Every permutation has one choice sequence with probability 1/n!. Copies protect the reset snapshot.

trace.zh:
原数组 [1,2,3]。
1. i=2，若抽到 j=0，则交换为 [3,2,1]。
2. i=1，若抽到 j=1，保持不变。
3. Reset 仍返回 [1,2,3]；上述只是六个等概率排列之一。
trace.en:
For [1,2,3]:
1. Swapping index two with zero gives [3,2,1].
2. Choosing one at the next step keeps it.
3. Reset still returns [1,2,3].

mapping.zh: 不知道链表长度也能等概率抽一个节点：顺序扫描，第 i 个节点以 1/i 的概率替换当前答案，这就是容量为 1 的蓄水池。
mapping.en: Reservoir sampling selects one node uniformly without knowing the list length.

why.zh: 第 i 个节点先以 1/i 入选，之后在第 j 步存活概率为 (j-1)/j。乘积为 (1/i)*(i/n)=1/n，因此所有 n 个节点等概率成为最终答案。
why.en: Node i is selected with probability 1/i and survives later steps with product i/n, giving final probability 1/n.

trace.zh:
链表 [10,20,30]。
1. 第一个值必选。
2. 第二个以 1/2 概率替换。
3. 第三个以 1/3 替换；前两个各以 (1/2)*(2/3)=1/3 留下。
trace.en:
For [10,20,30]:
1. Select the first initially.
2. Replace with the second with probability one-half.
3. The third replaces with probability one-third, leaving equal final probabilities.

mapping.zh: 目标值可能在多个下标出现，只对匹配目标的位置做蓄水池抽样。第 k 个匹配位置以 1/k 概率替换答案。
mapping.en: Apply reservoir sampling only to indices matching the target.

why.zh: 忽略非目标位置后，过程等价于对全部 m 个匹配位置做容量为 1 的蓄水池。第 k 个匹配被保留到结尾的概率为 (1/k)*(k/m)=1/m，因而所有合法下标等概率。
why.en: Ignoring other values gives a reservoir over the m matching indices. Each has final probability 1/m.

trace.zh:
nums=[4,7,4,4]，target=4。
1. 下标 0 首次匹配，必选。
2. 下标 2 以 1/2 替换。
3. 下标 3 以 1/3 替换，三处最终概率均为 1/3；下标 1 从不入选。
trace.en:
For [4,7,4,4] and target four:
1. Select index zero initially.
2. Index two replaces with probability one-half.
3. Index three replaces with probability one-third; index one is never eligible.

mapping.zh: 逐个试除会反复检查同一个合数。埃氏筛反过来枚举素数，把它的倍数统一标为合数，最后统计小于 n 的未标记整数。
mapping.en: The sieve marks multiples of each discovered prime instead of repeatedly testing each candidate.

why.zh: 任何合数都有不超过其平方根的素因子，所以会被筛掉。p*p 之前的 p 倍数已有更小素因子处理；未被筛掉的数没有真素因子，只能是素数。
why.en: Every composite has a prime factor no larger than its square root. Multiples below p*p were handled by smaller factors, and unmarked values are prime.

trace.en:
For n=10:
1. Two marks four, six and eight.
2. Three marks nine.
3. Two, three, five and seven remain.

mapping.zh: 丑数的素因子只能是 2、3、5。反复除尽这三个因子，若剩下 1，就不存在其他素因子。
mapping.en: Strip every factor of two, three and five; an ugly positive number reduces to one.

why.zh: 唯一素因数分解保证除尽三种允许因子后，余数只含其他素因子。余数为 1 等价于没有其他因子。1 本身没有不允许的素因子，按定义是丑数。
why.en: Unique prime factorization makes the remaining value contain exactly the disallowed prime factors. One has none and is ugly by definition.

trace.zh:
n=90。
1. 除以 2 得 45。
2. 除尽 3 得 5，再除 5 得 1。
3. 返回 true；若 n=14，除 2 后剩 7，返回 false。
trace.en:
For ninety:
1. Remove two to get forty-five.
2. Remove both threes and then five to reach one.
3. Fourteen instead leaves seven and fails.

mapping.zh: 每个大于 1 的丑数都来自更小丑数乘以 2、3 或 5。把这三条有序序列归并，保存各自尚未使用的最小候选下标。
mapping.en: Merge the three sorted streams obtained by multiplying earlier ugly numbers by two, three and five.

why.zh: 每条流递增且覆盖以对应因子生成的丑数。三流并集包含所有后续丑数，归并取全局最小不会跳过值；同时移动所有相等流头恰好去重。
why.en: The streams cover all later ugly numbers. Taking the minimum preserves order, and advancing every tied stream head removes duplicates.

trace.en:
Starting at one:
1. Merge candidates two, three and five.
2. Six appears in two streams, so advance both.
3. The tenth value is twelve.

mapping.zh: 本题的“丑数”指能被 a、b、c 至少一个整除，与只含特定素因子的定义不同。计数 C(x) 单调，可用容斥算出不超过 x 的合法数个数，再二分第 n 个。
mapping.en: Here a number qualifies if divisible by a, b or c. Inclusion-exclusion gives a monotone count for binary search.

why.zh: 容斥将重复被两种或三种因子覆盖的整数纠正为只计一次。C(x) 随 x 单调不减，且上界至少含 n 个最小因子的倍数，故二分首次达标位置恰为第 n 个合法数。lcm 超过上界后对所有计数贡献为零，封顶不改变结果。
why.en: Inclusion-exclusion counts each eligible integer once. The upper bound contains n multiples of the smallest divisor, and the first count reaching n is the desired value. Capped LCMs exceed every queried x and contribute zero.

trace.en:
For n=5 and divisors two, three and four:
1. Eligible values begin 2,3,4,6,8.
2. Count at seven is four, at eight is five.
3. Return eight.
